		</keybind>

		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="plugins.media-keys/mic-mute" key="XF86AudioMicMute">

		<keybind bridge="plugins.media-keys/volume-down" key="XF86AudioLowerVolume">

		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="plugins.media-keys/play" key="C-XF86AudioPlay">
			<action name="Execute" command="dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=org.buddiesofbudgie.BudgieMprisController /org/buddiesofbudgie/MprisController org.buddiesofbudgie.BudgieMprisController.PlayPause" />
		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="plugins.media-keys/pause" key="XF86AudioPause">
			<action name="Execute" command="dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=org.buddiesofbudgie.BudgieMprisController /org/buddiesofbudgie/MprisController org.buddiesofbudgie.BudgieMprisController.Pause" />
		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="plugins.media-keys/stop" key="XF86AudioStop">

		<keybind bridge="wm.keybindings/show-desktop" key="W-d">

		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="wm.keybindings/move-to-workspace-left" key="W-S-KP_Prior">
			<action name="SendToDesktop" to="left" wrap="no" />
		</keybind>
		<keybind bridge="wm.keybindings/move-to-workspace-left" key="W-S-A-Left">
			<action name="SendToDesktop" to="left" wrap="no" />

		<keybind bridge="wm.keybindings/move-to-workspace-left" key="C-S-A-Left">

		<keybind bridge="wm.keybindings/move-to-workspace-right" key="W-S-A-Right">
